description: Comparison implied by a masked equality not removed
notes: C translated from the IR reproducer in the issue, with the pointer null check replaced by an integer zero check and a bitwise & so that clang produces the issue's flat and/or IR (with && clang emits a branch and a phi, which keeps the same miss). expected.ll from the issue target. Close to #225655 (an equality ruled out by a masked test on an incoming edge), added separately as llvm-issue-225655. expected.ll proven correct (refinement) by Alive2 alive-tv, 2026-10-27: src = clang trunk -O3 IR of src.c (godbolt cclang_trunk, -O3 --target=x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu -march=skylake -emit-llvm -S -g0) renamed @src, tgt = expected.ll renamed @tgt, identical signature; output 'Transformation seems to be correct!' with no warning. Run on Alive2's own Compiler Explorer instance (alive2.llvm.org/ce, compiler id 'alive'), since godbolt.org does not host alive-tv.
